clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Graveborn is an ancestral spirit who manifests just southeast of Brill during the Lunar Festival. Appearing as a spectral earthen elder, he honors travelers and guides pilgrims searching for other ancient spirits scattered throughout northern Lordaeron.

Appearing just beyond the Forsaken town of Brill, Elder Graveborn stands among the haunted woods of Tirisfal Glades as part of the worldwide Lunar Festival. Despite the blighted surroundings and the troubled state of the kingdom, the spectral elder offers peaceful greetings to travelers seeking the festival's traditional blessings. In addition to bestowing his own ancestral wisdom, Graveborn shares news of other elders lingering nearby—pointing pilgrims toward spirits abiding in the Undercity, the Sepulcher, and across the Plaguelands.
